outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with the upper door handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 70–90, image and left_ego_image). The door remains visibly open, angled away from the oven body, through frame 152 (image and left_ego_image). No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is established; the door is not shown fully lowered, but opening is visibly achieved.
